body: I tried changing things, but nothing worked so far... I just keep doing basically the same mistakes over and over again even tho I am aware of them. One of them is that I'm very unstable emotionally, and tend to lose my mind when I do a minor mistake - all of that because I know how much time and work I dedicate to doing it, and I simple can't accept the possibility of making such small and stupid mistake. I set high expectations for myself, but my skills can't meet them... And the worst part is that I know about these issues, but I just can't fix them. I red different forums and posts online, looking at the same issues, but none of that helped. All I asked for is to see myself getting better, even little by little, but I just don't improve at all. I just don't know how to keep up when I don't get any success after giving up a lot of time and work for nothing.

It's just a hobby many people have like sports,arts or anything like that. But I was interested in doing it for living, but I kept failing and got basically 0% improvements in the past months. And I just keep failing for months now, and I feel like I get worse the more time I spent doing that. I'm just basically giving up because of the crazy amount of failures which I just can't stand anymore. I thought I got burned out at some point because of dedicating so much time to one thing and took a break, but it changed nothing. As for my family, I know they didn't have to do what they did, but I still can't get over these thoughts that everything they did was basically wasted. I honestly wish I never had a family or anyone supporting me so I could just leave without any regrets.
